plan.title: Release behind a flag
plan.author: pratos with Claude Code
plan.summary: `decide()` already refuses Resolve without the `resolve-thread` flag, but the screen still offers it. This stage makes the screen ask the same Flags service, then ships to production through `docs/RELEASE.md`'s three questions: is it right, can you watch it, can you undo it.
plan.current: cp-09 runs seven browser tests green. `resolve-thread` is seeded off, on for admin and pratos, and checked in `decide()`. Sam still sees Resolve, types a decision, and meets a refusal. Production has no accounts until you add one.
discoveries: `Flags.enabledFor` in `apps/api/src/services.ts` is what `Commands.dispatch` hands `decide()`; the new route calls the same function, so they cannot disagree.
A percentage is a stable bucket per participant and flag (`bucket()`), so `pct 5` keeps the same people on.
`just flag user` appends to the allowlist; `just flag off` also clears the allowlist and percentage.
`/healthz` returns `version.id`, the id `just rollback api <id>` needs.
The pull request template asks the three release questions on every PR.
plan.endState: On production, Resolve appears for you after `flag user` and a tab switch, with no deploy, and disappears after `flag off`. Sam reads why it is missing. The PR answers the three questions.
notDoing: A flags page for people who are not admins.
Pushing flag changes to open tabs; the page rechecks on focus.
Removing the flag after full rollout; that is a later release.
A new migration; 0001 and 0002 only add tables.
plan.approach: The screen first, so the flag decides what people see. Then `docs/RELEASE.md`'s three questions, in order, each a phase.

spec.question: Who has resolve-thread on, and how does it widen or go back?
spec.diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Off: flag off
  Off --> You: flag user, you
  You --> Slice: flag user, the people you interviewed
  Slice --> Percent: flag pct 5, then 25
  Percent --> Everyone: flag on
  You --> Off: flag off
  Slice --> Off: flag off
  Percent --> Off: flag off
  Everyone --> Off: flag off

steps.caption: It ships off: nobody sees Resolve, and decide() refuses it.
On for you first, on production, with no deploy.
Then the people you interviewed, told it is on.
Then 5 percent, then 25, watching errors and decisions.
Then everyone.
From any step, flag off is one command and seconds.

manual.text: `just flag user resolve-thread sam`, back to Sam's tab: Resolve appears.

phases.name: 1 · Is it right?
phases.goal: The PR opens with the user's sentence, you resolved a real thread today on `just up`, and one signal is named.

changes.intent: The PR body: the user's sentence, and the signal: `DecisionRecorded` per week, with a number.

manual.text: The PR's first line is a sentence Sam would say.
You resolved a real thread today, following `docs/TESTING.md`.

phases.name: 2 · Can you watch it?
phases.goal: Migrations applied by hand, main deployed from GitHub, you are an admin on production, and the flag widens one step at a time.

changes.intent: Applied by hand before the deploy; both only add tables.
A push to main checks, then deploys api then web; a pending migration stops it.
Each step is one `GH_REMOTE=1 just flag` command; no deploy between steps.

contract.code:
just migrate-remote                                    # or Actions → deploy → Run workflow
git push origin main                                   # deploys from GitHub
GH_REMOTE=1 just user-add you@example.com "You" admin  # asks for the password
GH_REMOTE=1 just flag off resolve-thread               # how it ships
GH_REMOTE=1 just flag user resolve-thread <you>        # you first
GH_REMOTE=1 just flag user resolve-thread <them>       # the people you interviewed
GH_REMOTE=1 just flag pct resolve-thread 5             # then 25, then: just flag on

automated.text: resolve-thread, off, your id on the allowlist

manual.text: On production, Resolve appears for you after a tab switch, with no deploy.
At each step, errors and `DecisionRecorded` are watched for a day.

phases.name: 3 · Can you undo it?
phases.goal: The PR names both ways back before shipping, and you have used the first: Resolve gone in seconds, without a deploy.

changes.intent: 'Can you undo it?' names the flag-off command and the live `version.id`.

contract.code:
GH_REMOTE=1 just flag off resolve-thread   # the feature is wrong: seconds, no deploy
curl -s https://greenhouse-api.<subdomain>.workers.dev/healthz | jq .version.id
just rollback api <version-id>             # the code is broken; same for web

changes.intent: Anything that went wrong gets a note here before the retry.

manual.text: After flag off and a tab switch, Resolve is gone on production.
The PR held the version id before the deploy, not after.
